user.title: Awesome Theme Collection
user.description: Installs and manages the Awesome themes for Home Assistant.

areas.title: Awesome Theme Collection
areas.description: Enable or disable the desired theme areas. Disabling an area removes its associated themes and backgrounds managed by this integration.

metal.title: Awesome-Metal-Themes
metal.description: Configure the following areas to suit your preferences.

themes.name: Selection
themes.description: Select the Metal themes that you want to keep installed.

backgrounds.name: Backgrounds
backgrounds.description: Configure dashboard and popup background images and their colors. Choose backgrounds and colors that match the design mode.

sections.name: Sections
sections.description: Configure section spacing, border color and section backgrounds. Choose backgrounds and colors that match the design mode.

data.section_border_color_metal: Border color (when a section background is active)

data_description.section_background_always_set_metal: Background is set even if no section background has been selected.

cards.name: Cards
cards.description: Configure the card radius and control buttons backgrounds.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.description: Configure the sidebar title, item typography, text colors and backgrounds.

data.sidebar_item_selected_text_color_dark_me: Selected item text color - Dark Mode
data.sidebar_item_selected_text_color_light_m: Selected item text color - Light Mode

toolbar.name: Header Toolbar
toolbar.description: Configure header bar item typography, text colors and backgrounds.

data.toolbar_item_selected_text_color_dark_me: Selected item text color - Dark Mode
data.toolbar_item_selected_text_color_light_m: Selected item text color - Light Mode

icons.name: Icons
icons.description: Configure icon size, glow and inactive icon colors. These settings apply to card icons, the sidebar, header and forms.

data_description.icon_size_metal: These settings apply to card icons, the sidebar, header and forms.
data_description.icons_glow_metal: Icons with status='On', such as lamps, switches, sockets, etc.

fonts.name: Font - Sizes
fonts.description: Configure font sizes for Metal themes. Values between 8px and 46px. Setting font sizes too large may cause display issues!

data_description.font_size_xs_metal: Small status indicators, short hints and compact labels
data_description.font_size_s_metal: Secondary text, subtitles, timestamps and small captions
data_description.font_size_m_metal: Normal text, standard labels and entity names
data_description.font_size_l_metal: Highlighted text, important status information and card headings
data_description.font_size_4xl_metal: Very large figures, temperature or energy consumption
data_description.font_size_5xl_metal: Especially prominent numbers, e.g. on a wall-mounted tablet

text_colors.name: Font - Colors
text_colors.description: Here you can configure the font colors that are most commonly used. Only adjust the colors so that they remain clearly legible in the relevant design mode.

data_description.disabled_text_color_dark_metal: e.g. when the field is disabled (default: #636366)
data_description.disabled_text_color_light_metal: e.g. when the field is disabled (default: #8E8E8E)

primary_colors.name: Primary Colors
primary_colors.description: Configure primary and accent colors for dark and light mode.

data_description.primary_color_dark_metal: e.g. borders and backgrounds of certain control elements (default: #0A5CFF)
data_description.accent_color_dark_metal: e.g. certain switches or active elements (default: #FFB200)
data_description.primary_color_light_metal: e.g. borders and backgrounds of certain control elements (default: #0A5CFF)
data_description.accent_color_light_metal: e.g. certain switches or active elements (default: #BA4B00)
